summary: HelloFresh is german meal-kit provider, founded in 2011. Type: listed company. About 19,012 employees (Wikidata). Revenue Q4916 7.6 billion (2023). insights.one_liner: Berlin-based meal-kit company with Benelux offices in Amsterdam and Bleiswijk; IND sponsor, but it has issued two profit warnings this year.

culture.text: Office perks include fresh homemade lunches for €20 a month, weekly Friday drinks, quarterly strategy sessions and team events.
Applications need a CV and a cover letter, and it aims to reply within 5 business days.
Open roles here are mostly operations and supply chain, in Amsterdam and the Bleiswijk site.

open.text: HelloFresh Benelux B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Half of its 6 jobs here don't need Dutch, and half mention visa support.

growth.text: Staff grew from 4,477 in 2019 to 19,595 in 2022, then dipped to 19,012 in 2023.
2023 revenue was €7.5966 billion with net profit of €19.4 million.
Cut its 2026 outlook as customer growth faltered, its second profit warning this year.

worth_knowing.text: A class action claims HelloFresh sent unsolicited texts to numbers on the US Do Not Call Registry.
